videos.description: The Pokémon Trading Card Game isn't just a game, it's an economy. Livestreamers provide vicarious dopamine hits to viewers who tune in to watch them open booster packs, and the rarest cards can resell for hundreds or even thousands of dollars. The game's 30th anniversary collection just launched, putting more copies of the game's rarest cards back into circulation. videos.description: It's a confusing time right now for gaming. Video games are becoming an increasingly expensive hobby. Games are expensive to make, too, and companies want to sell the most lucrative ones they can: Sony and Microsoft are cutting jobs to refocus on blockbusters. videos.title: Would you want to know if Ghostface is at your door?
videos.description:
Would you want to know if Ghostface is at your door? New AI-powered text descriptions on Ring, Nest, and Apple Home-compatible video doorbells claim to tell you exactly what's happening on your porch without making you wait for a video clip to buffer. I put them to the test to see how smart they are, and if any of them could catch Ghostface. Read my full review at theverge.com.
